I have been farming this land since I was a young girl, and I know what works here in Iringa. I save my own maize seeds every year because they grow well in our soil and I do not need to spend money at the shop. I am too old now to do the heavy digging myself, so my children and grandchildren come to help with planting and weeding, but we do not have money to pay workers from outside or to buy chemical fertilizer. I always spread cow manure on the plot before the rains come, and that has been enough to give us a good harvest.
